title: TRADE REQUEST (MV) Patchwork – Atmospheric RPG that needs YOUR help!

posts.author: 4sterGaps
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I am Aster!​
Today, I'd like to share with you an idea that I hope can grow into a rich, fully fleshed-out experience.
Patchwork
is an atmospheric 2D RPG where you play as
Patch
, a stitched-together being tasked with repairing a pastel, fabric-like world that is slowly falling apart.
​
(My little doll themselves, in the cotton above!)
On the surface, Patch is seen as a savior. You fight monsters, harvest their unique threads, and use them to sew up tears in the fabric of the world, mend broken landscapes, and unlock new abilities!
But… beneath the embroidery lies an unease. Every repair, every stitch, comes at a cost. What appears as healing is also
consumption.
Patch uses the very fabric of life. The more you “fix,” the more the world begins to lose its vibrancy, its creativity, and its imperfections that gave it soul.
It’s a melancholic, bittersweet experience. One that explores creation, destruction, and the dangers of “fixing” everything that you deem broken, by using the world around you as your fuel.
Are you saving the world, or slowly suffocating it?
​
Think
Paper Mario: TTYD
and typical JRPGS (In terms of combat mechanics) meet
Undertale
(In terms of story depth and intrigue), with an underlying horror edge!
Positions/Roles Needed​
2D Pixel Artist(!)
→ Character sprites, environment tiles, UI elements. This is by far my highest priority at the moment, as I just lack the knack for designing tilesets and more intricate pixel art.
Programmer (RPG Maker plugin/eventing focus)
→ Combat system (timed hits / Paper Mario-inspired) and resource mechanics.
(I will personally be delving into this aspect more and attempting to do a majority myself)
My Role(s)/Position(s)​
Writer / Narrative Designer
→ Story, dialogue and worldbuilding.
Game Designer
→ Core mechanics, systems, progression.
Pixel Artist (Basic!)
→ Prototyping sprites and mockups. Would prefer to not do this.
Creative Direction
→ Visual + thematic consistency.
Skill Trade:​
Narrative design & writing
(dialogue, branching choices, lore)
Game/system design documentation
Programming and Scripting within the Engine
Sprite Samples:​
Final Notes​
This is a hobby/side project, no pay, purely passion-driven and collaboration-focused. The goal is to build a playable demo first, then expand. If you’re into narrative-driven RPGs with unsettling twists, this might be your kind of project.
DM me here, leave a comment on this post or email:
KyuMarRem@gmail.com
